revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Yes the reading is very clearly Μαρεπκῆμις. This had, however, already been noted in taken up by BL 7.240. Encode accordingly.
Vote - AcceptText - good correction; obviously Pi instead of Ny; Marepkemis attested in variant spellings in P.Thomas, SB 23, P.Lips. II, CPR 28 (cf. WörterListen)

Submit - in ll. 4, 8 and 30 the personal name Μαρενκῆμις has been corrected to Μαρεπκῆμις. That is l. 4 Μαρενκήμει -> Μαρεπκήμει. In l. 8 Μαρενκήμιος -> Μαρεπκήμιος. In l. 30 Μαρενκῆμις -> Μαρεπκῆμις. Actually only in l 30 the name appears in the text. In ll. 4 and 8 it is restored in the lacunas. The photo can be seen in http://www.psi-online.it/images/orig/PSI%20X%201131%20r.jpg?1365958506, where there is a cleat Π and not N.
